title: Objective hearing test for babies (ABR, ASSR)
what: Sensors are stuck on your baby's head, and quiet sounds are played into the ears. The device records the brain's response and shows how your baby hears.
why: When a baby did not pass the hearing screening at the maternity hospital, when there is a risk of hearing loss, or when the exact level of hearing needs to be found.
duration: usually 30 to 90 minutes; the report is ready right away or the same day
tell_doctor: If your baby did not pass the hearing screening after birth
If hearing loss runs in your family
How your pregnancy and birth went
If your baby has an ear infection or a runny nose

prepare.title: Sleep
prepare.text: The test is done while your baby sleeps. Try to keep them awake before the visit so they arrive sleepy.

prepare.title: Feeding
prepare.text: It helps to feed your baby right before the test. After eating, they fall asleep.

prepare.title: Health
prepare.text: If your baby has a runny nose or an ear infection, call. The test may be moved.

prepare.title: Older children
prepare.text: Sometimes the test is done during sleep with light sedation. The doctor will explain how to prepare.

bring: A bottle, or be ready to breastfeed
steps: Your baby is fed and put to sleep
The skin on the forehead and behind the ears is wiped
A few small sensors are stuck on
Soft earphones are put in the ears
While your baby sleeps, sounds are played and the response is recorded
feel: It does not hurt your baby
If your baby wakes up, the test is paused
after: You are usually told the result right away
If hearing is reduced, the doctor will tell you what to do next
The earlier a problem is found, the better treatment works

faq.q: Why does my baby need to sleep?
faq.a: During sleep there is no movement, so the device records the weak signals more accurately.

faq.q: If my baby failed the screening at the hospital, does that mean they cannot hear?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Often it is fluid in the ear after birth. This test will show for sure.

reminders.text: Your baby's hearing test is tomorrow. Bring them sleepy and feed them before the test. Bring a blanket and a diaper.
